title_sq: Penthouse - Për Shitje - Rruga e Kosovarëve, Tiranë
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje nje Penthouse i cili eshte i pozicionuar ne katin e 9 te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor me fasade te ventiluar. Eshte i organizuar ne nje soxhorno spacioze ku ambjenti i gatimit eshte i vecuar nga ai i ndenjes,dy dhoma gjumi me garderobe,dy tualete,dhe tarraca e cila lidhet me shkalle te brendshme me apartamentin. 
Ne cmim gjithashtu jane te perfshira dhe 3 poste parkime te mbyllura me qepen
title_en: Penthouse - For Sale - Rruga e Kosovare, Tirana
description_en: A Penthouse is offered for sale, which is located on the 9th floor of a new building with an elevator and a ventilated facade. It is organized in a spacious living room where the cooking area is separate from the living room, two bedrooms with wardrobes, two toilets, and a terrace which is connected by an internal staircase to the apartment. The price also includes 3 closed parking spaces
